exposure: timing of bacteremia presentation (antepartum, intrapartum, or postpartum)
outcome: distribution of pathogens in blood cultures
maternal bacteremia-related admission to intensive care unit (ICU)
cohort: The study included 46,103 women who delivered at Galilee Medical Center between 2012-2023, of whom 104 had confirmed maternal bacteremia from 24 weeks gestation to 7 days postpartum.
finding: Intrapartum ampicillin use was significantly associated with an increased incidence of ampicillin-resistant Enterobacteriaceae bacteremia in mothers with postpartum bacteremia and in neonates, particularly in preterm deliveries.
gest_age: Preterm and term deliveries, with observations beginning from 24 weeks of gestation.
